thread:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 3xx->5xx surge detected for service=inference-prod in us-west-2, rate > 5% over 1m window. page=oncall
Neha: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs.
Neha: initial impact — internal metrics show increased 502s + p95 latency jump from 180ms -> 1.1s for generation endpoints. Customers likely seeing failures, but embeddings look unaffected.
Mike: seeing traces — a subset of requests hit backend pool timeouts after a recent autoscaler bumpless restart. stacks show "upstream closed connection" errors.
Alice: sharing a quick log sample that correlates with the spike:
```
ts=2026-03-14T21:47:12Z level=warn svc=inference path=/v1/generate status=502 err="upstream closed connection" request_id=abcd-1234 pool=nodepool-17
ts=2026-03-14T21:47:12Z level=info svc=autoscaler event=drain node=nodepool-17 reason=scale-in
```
Neha: that matches. Looks like nodepool drains are triggering short blips of 502s while KV cache warmup occurs. This is noisy but customer visible.
Neha: live mitigation ideas — 1) lower severity of the current 5xx alert (avoid noisy paging), 2) add a log-signature to filter autoscaler-drain-originated 502s from true model failures, 3) create a temporary dashboard panel for affected route group.
SRE-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-314 - inference-prod us-west 5xx surge. PagerDuty incident linked.
pagerduty-bot: page sent to Neha (oncall). escalation policy: immediate.
Mike: for quick noise suppression we can add a query-level exclusion that matches the autoscaler drain message. proposed regex: `pool=[a-z0-9-]+ reason=scale-in` — that would capture the drain-caused 502s.
Alice: I drafted a log-alert patch we can apply as a stopgap. Query tweak (Datadog-style example):
```
logs("service:inference AND status:502")
  .exclude("pool:nodepool-* AND message:scale-in")
  .rollup("count", 60)
  .threshold(> 30)
```
Mike: or in our internal LogQL-ish format: `|~ ":reason=scale-in"` — something fast to roll out.
Neha: Live action: I'll mute the page for 30m and lower alert to P2, then apply the exclusion rule. Leaving a clear audit.
Neha: applying alert change now.
SRE-Bot: Alert policy updated by Neha: severity -> P2, notification windows changed.
Neha: applying log exclusion rule (patch):
```
# temporary rule: ignore autoscaler drain 502s
source: logs
filter: service=="inference" AND status==502
exclude_regex: "pool=[a-z0-9-]+ reason=scale-in"
ttl: 30m  # temporary
```
Neha: patch applied, verifying.
Mike: seeing immediate drop in noisy firing count. still a tiny tail of errors, but below paging threshold. :thumbsup:
Lee: taking over the thread for handoff — I'm oncall for the next 2 hours. summary: nodepool drain causes brief 502s during instance replacement; mitigated by temporary exclusion and reduced alert severity.
Lee: I'll follow up with a more robust signature to distinguish backend drain vs model runtime failures. Proposed signature to add to rule-engine (regex capture + label):
```
regex: "pool=(?P<pool>[a-z0-9-]+) reason=(?P<reason>scale-in|reboot)"
label: drain_event=true
match_condition: status==502 && drain_event==true
action: suppress_from_pager
```
Lee: also creating a dashboard tile with: 1) 5xx rate by worker pool, 2) p95 gen latency, 3) number of concurrent drains in last 15m.
Alice: FYI — a few customers hit retries in the 60s window. we should run a quick churn report and email impacted accounts if any retries > 5 in 10m. I'm grabbing logs for customer correlation now.
Neha: assigning followup tickets:
- INFRA-8791 (postmortem + permanent signature rollout)
- INFRA-8792 (dashboard + alert refactor)
- INFRA-8793 (customer-impact audit + comms)
Lee: I'll own INFRA-8792. Neha please own INFRA-8791, Alice INFRA-8793.
Neha: confirmed.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2026-314 status: mitigated -> monitoring. created tasks INFRA-8791, INFRA-8792, INFRA-8793 and linked.
Mike: small note for the permanent rule — make sure we capture both the explicit "reason=scale-in" and the backend message "upstream closed connection" with pool metadata; otherwise we'll miss other autoscaler variants.
Lee: good call. we'll include both patterns and add a threshold so we don't suppress legitimately high-error windows.
Neha: post-incident checklist:

- [x] apply temporary exclusion rule
- [x] handoff to next oncall (Lee)
- [ ] permanent signature + rollout (INFRA-8791)

- [ ] customer impact assessment and comms (INFRA-8793)
Alice: adding note to the ticket about the exact log samples and the customer ids I've pulled.
Lee: thanks — I'll schedule a short sync with infra to adjust autoscaler drain grace handling so warmup doesn't induce user-visible 502s.
Neha: closing the paging loop; monitoring for 20 more minutes then will move to postmortem.
